priorityList: Cast Reap on cooldown whenever it is available.
Cast Voidblade right before entering Void Metamorphosis.
Cast Pierce the Veil before Collapsing Star or a Moment of Craving buffed Cull.
Cast Cull with 4 Soul Fragments or if it will overcap charges.
Reap is used rotationally due to the large damage it deals. Regardless of your transformation state, it's used on cooldown to deal high damage and generate Fury.

For Void-Scarred, the melee combo depends on your target count. Voidblade / Pierce the Veil are only used as a damage amp with Devourer's Bite - use Voidblade right before entering Void Metamorphosis, and then Pierce the Veil whenever it will buff Collapsing Star and/or a Moment of Craving buffed Cull.
Cast The Hunt to put it on cooldown.
Cast Voidblade to put it on cooldown.

For Void-Scarred, the melee combo is quite robust. Depending on your current form, the sequence is: Outside: The Hunt / Voidblade ➜ Hungering Slash ➜ Vengeful Retreat Inside: Predator's Wake / Pierce the Veil ➜ Reaper's Toll ➜ Vengeful Retreat These can be cast as isolated 3-part combos, or a longer extended 6-part cycle.
